summary.overview: Eight papers discussed in order from 1908.11053 (SubQG query generation: F1, precision/recall, top-1/top-5, substructure accuracy) first to 1806.09652 (NMT for low-resource languages via induced bilingual lexicon: OpenNMT Transformer, Moses SMT baseline, Siamese BiRNN sentence extraction) last. Intervening: 1906.01010 (identifying bipolar disorder users via self-reported diagnosis statements on Twitter/Reddit, manual blog recruitment); 1603.08868 (linguistic complexity features: lexical, syntactic, semantic, length); 1905.08067 (behavioural Twitter features: mentions, HITS hub/authority); 2002.00175 (UIT-ViIC Vietnamese captioning: NIC and Pytorch-tutorial models, CNN encoder/RNN-LSTM decoder); 2003.11687 (SEVA concept recognition: fine-tuned BERT F1 0.89, spaCy baseline, 80-20 split); 1805.11598 (Polyglot SRL: combined CoNLL 2009 language-pair resources, multilingual word vectors, no parallel data). No unresolved references.
